features: FLOWER SHOWER CURTAIN: The stall shower curtain with flowers is suitable for any type of bathroom furniture. Creative and unique pattern makes you enjoy your bath time.

FLORAL SHOWER CURTAIN: 100% polyester small shower curtain serves healthy and long life use, applicable to home decoration. Super waterproof fabric is treated to let water beads stay on the surface, quick to repel and dry.
REINFORCED TOP HEM: This RV shower curtain has a reinforced top hem, which makes sure the short shower curtain never falls when you are in the shower.
IN THE PACKAGE: You will receive a 36"W x 72"H wildflower shower curtain and 12 C-shaped hooks included.
QUALITY GUARANTEE: If you have any issues upon receiving the item, please contact us immediately. We will respond within 24 hours and make sure your issue is well taken care of.
